c04.VALUE_GEOMETRY: a SAMPLE of observations (here 2D uint8 frames) + a parametrised FAMILY of key functions observation -> hashable; output: parameters + a partition size
c04.STATE_GEOMETRY: a rotating sample of recent observations; the archive to be re-keyed (former grids on disk); the current key parameters
c04.CONTROL_GEOMETRY: the exploration loop decides WHEN (every recompute_dynamic_state_every frames or when the archive exceeds max_archive_size); the organ decides WHICH parameters
c04.ORDER_METRIC: a hashable key per observation (equality only); entropy over occupancy counts; |n - target| distance; no metric on observations themselves
c04.REVERSIBILITY: NO encoding/decoding boundary for the objective; the shipped family (downscale) is one-way and image-specific
c04.FOREIGN_SEMANTICS: that observations are images (the family's parameters are shape and pixel depth); that recent frames represent the archive; the target granularity constant
c04.MINIMUM_CONSUMER_CONTRACT: a consumer that (a) holds a sample of observations, (b) can supply a key-function family over them, (c) keys an archive by the result and is willing to re-key it
c04.EXISTING_PROMETHEUS_MATCH: NONE. Archaeon's H3 descriptors are declared, fixed-length, never learned (Vivarium #182); no site learns its own discretisation today
c04.runnable_outside_ancestor: SPECIFIED (pure Python over numpy arrays + Counter; needs imdownscale or any family) -- NOT RUN (no managed pin)

c01.VALUE_GEOMETRY: hashable key -> record{score, path length, payload}
c01.CONTROL_GEOMETRY: called per step of every returned trajectory by the loop
c01.ORDER_METRIC: a total order on (score, -length); key equality
c01.FOREIGN_SEMANTICS: that the payload (a restore token) is meaningful to whoever resumes
c01.MINIMUM_CONSUMER_CONTRACT: an archive keyed by a descriptor with a fitness order
c01.EXISTING_PROMETHEUS_MATCH: Archaeon h3_replay admission rule; MAP-Elites organ (inventory) -- hence RECURRENCE
c01.consumable_by_existing_site: YES in principle (H3 already has one) -- which is why it is a recurrence, not a delivery

c03.VALUE_GEOMETRY: an opaque token the WORLD produces and accepts back
c03.STATE_GEOMETRY: the world's full internal state at capture time
c03.CONTROL_GEOMETRY: the loop decides when to resume; the world performs it
c03.REVERSIBILITY: the token IS a reversible encoding of the world state -- owned by the world
c03.FOREIGN_SEMANTICS: exact determinism; that a token captured under one wrapper configuration is valid later
c03.EXISTING_PROMETHEUS_MATCH: NONE as a kind operation; H5 CA state is trivially resumable but no kind exposes 'resume from artifact'
c03.runnable_outside_ancestor: NONE (nothing to run; the capability is the world's)
c03.consumable_by_existing_site: NO CURRENT CONSUMER (converted to pressure P-A)
